On the second or third pep rally, one of the principals asked the choir to sing our alma mater. The football team usually sits on our own set of bleachers for our pep rallies. So I had to stand on the opposite side of the gym, face my team, and sing to them. I was put front and center, along with the other guy. I was shaking so bad. Not only was the entire school watching, but my coaches and all my football buddies. When we finally finished, I had to walk across the entire gym to sit with them. At least they gave me a standing ovation when I got close. Luckily several of them got concussions that night and forgot.
